title: Female Nomination and Party Vote Share in US Gubernatorial Elections
abstract: arXiv:2608.23051v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: What happens to a party's vote share when it nominates a woman for executive office? The evidence on female candidates is dominated by legislative races and by designs that pool parties and periods into a single average effect, which is typically null. This paper builds a new county-level panel of US gubernatorial elections - 578 races in 49 states from 1980 to 2024, reconstructed and audited from primary sources - and estimates party-specific, time-varying nomination effects with a stacked difference-in-differences design around within-state transitions from male to female nominees. The average null conceals a sharp asymmetry. Republican transitions to a female nominee since 2016 are followed by a county-level vote-share decline of 6.5 percentage points, robust across cohort, weighting and inference checks. translated_title: 美国州长选举中女性提名与政党得票率
translated_abstract: 摘要：当一个政党提名女性担任行政职务时，其得票率会发生什么变化？关于女性候选人的证据主要来自立法选举，且通常采用将各政党和时期合并为一个平均效应的设计，这一效应通常为零。本文构建了一个新的美国州长选举县级面板数据——涵盖1980年至2024年间49个州的578场选举，这些数据从原始资料中重建并审核——并采用堆叠双重差分设计，围绕州内从男性提名者到女性提名者的转变，估计了政党特定且随时间变化的提名效应。平均零效应掩盖了明显的非对称性。自2016年以来，共和党提名女性候选人的转变，导致县级得票率下降6.5个百分点，这一结果在队列、加权和推断检验中均保持稳健。对于民主党提名者，未检测到可比的平均差异。调查投票诊断与需求侧因素一致。
tldr: 本文发现美国州长选举中，共和党自2016年提名女性候选人会导致县级得票率显著下降6.5个百分点，而民主党提名女性无显著影响，揭示了平均零效应背后的非对称性。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that Republican nominations of female candidates in US gubernatorial elections since 2016 lead to a significant 6.5 percentage point decline in county-level vote share, while Democratic female nominations show no comparable effect, revealing asymmetry hidden behind the average null result.
